messages:
ana: Quick FYI: we merged RFC + SDK patch that normalizes request grouping behavior in sdk-core 4.0.0-rc1. This changes how 'batch_key' is treated (now deprecated in favor of 'request_grouping.id').
drew: summary of impact?
ana: (typo, ana) Short: grouping semantics are the same, but default grouping key provenance changed from implicit session->explicit id. Most apps see no change. Some reranking & deterministic-order pipelines that relied on implicit session inference may observe different batch composition.
marta: is this a breaking change? should teams pin?
ana: It's a minor-breaking behavioral change for workloads that relied on implicit behavior. We labeled rc1 and documented a compatibility shim. Recommend pinning to 3.x if you need old behavior.
qa-bot: CI smoke: sdk-core 4.0.0-rc1 test matrix passed (linux/cpu, linux/gpu, macos) but flagged two flaky tests related to ordering in rerank-suite.
docs-bot: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/934 "SDK: request_grouping rename, migration guide, and compatibility shim". Added migration checklist and sample CI snippet.
drew: paste the shim here?
nana: here's the quick shim you can add in CI to retain old semantics while you migrate:
```bash
# temporary compatibility shim for implicit batch_key behavior
if [ -f ./redwood_config.yml ]; then
  yq eval '.request_grouping.id |= . // .legacy.batch_key' -i redwood_config.yml || true
fi
# pin SDK until migration completed
pip install redwood-sdk-core==3.14.7
```
marta: timeline and deprecation plan?
nana: Deprecation note in PR: "batch_key will be fully removed in 90 days from stable 4.0.0 release. We will keep the compatibility shim available in the CLI for 120 days." Risk = medium for rerank pipelines, low for typical generation.
support: Heads-up: we'll message customers on active support plans if they use reranking or ordering features. Can you add a short blurb for support templates?
docs-bot: Added support blurb to PR and created internal summary doc at /internal/docs/migrations/request_grouping.md (private).
drew: i'll post an announcement in #eng and #customers-impacting tomorrow with links. Any objections?
marta: none. Please call out action steps: 1) scan repos for batch_key usage, 2) apply shim or pin, 3) test rerank determinism, 4) plan to migrate to request_grouping.id.
nana: thanks all. Ping me for longer runway if you need it. :rocket:
